stem: A company plans to use an Amazon Snowball Edge device to transfer files to the AWS Cloud. Which activities related to a Snowball Edge device are available to the company at no cost?

options.label: A
options.text: Use of the Snowball Edge appliance for a 10-day period

options.label: B
options.text: The transfer of data out of Amazon S3 and to the Snowball Edge appliance

options.label: C
options.text: The transfer of data from the Snowball Edge appliance into Amazon S3

options.label: D
options.text: Daily use of the Snowball Edge appliance after 10 days

explanation: Importing data from a Snowball Edge device into Amazon S3 is free. You are charged a service fee per job, which covers 10 days of on-site use, and a per-day fee after that; data transferred out of S3 to a device is charged at normal data transfer rates.

stem: A company has deployed applications on Amazon EC2 instances. The company needs to assess application vulnerabilities and must identify infrastructure deployments that do not meet best practices. Which AWS service can the company use to meet these requirements?
explanation: Amazon Inspector runs automated vulnerability scans of the software on EC2 instances, container images and Lambda functions, and reports findings ranked by severity. Trusted Advisor checks account configuration against best practices but does not scan for application vulnerabilities, and GuardDuty detects threat activity in logs rather than unpatched software.

stem: A company has a centralized group of users with large file storage requirements that have exceeded the space available on premises. The company wants to extend its file storage capabilities for this group while retaining the performance benefit of sharing content locally. What is the MOST operationally efficient AWS solution for this scenario?

options.label: A
options.text: Create an Amazon S3 bucket for each user. Mount each bucket by using an S3 file system mounting utility.

options.label: B
options.text: Configure and deploy an AWS Storage Gateway file gateway. Connect each user’s workstation to the file gateway.

options.label: C
options.text: Move each user’s working environment to Amazon WorkSpaces. Set up an Amazon WorkDocs account for each user.

options.label: D
options.text: Deploy an Amazon EC2 instance and attach an Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) Provisioned IOPS volume. Share the EBS volume directly with the users.

explanation: AWS Storage Gateway: Connect [on premises] with [AWS S3]file gateway: one of the AWS Storage Gateway's interface.

stem: According to security best practices, how should an Amazon EC2 instance be given access to an Amazon S3 bucket?

options.label: A
options.text: Hard code an IAM user’s secret key and access key directly in the application, and upload the file.

options.label: B
options.text: Store the IAM user’s secret key and access key in a text file on the EC2 instance, read the keys, then upload the file.

options.label: C
options.text: Have the EC2 instance assume a role to obtain the privileges to upload the file.

options.label: D
options.text: Modify the S3 bucket policy so that any service can upload to it at any time.

explanation: An EC2 instance gets credentials by assuming an IAM role through an instance profile, so AWS issues short-lived credentials and rotates them automatically. Every other option stores a long-lived access key on the instance or opens the bucket to everyone.

stem: Which option is a customer responsibility when using Amazon DynamoDB under the AWS Shared Responsibility Model?

options.label: D
options.text: Encryption of data at rest in DynamoDB

explanation: Access to DynamoDB tables Under the AWS Shared Responsibility Model, controlling and managing access to AWS services, including Amazon DynamoDB tables, is a customer responsibility. While AWS takes care of the physical infrastructure, patching, and encryption of data at rest in DynamoDB, customers are responsible for setting up proper access controls, authentication, and authorization to protect their data and resources.

stem: Which option is a perspective that includes foundational capabilities of the AWS Cloud Adoption Framework (AWS CAF)?
explanation: C is the correct answer !The 6 AWS CAF perspectives are: Business, People, Governance, Platform, Security and Operations.

stem: A company is running and managing its own Docker environment on Amazon EC2 instances. The company wants an alternative to help manage cluster size, scheduling, and environment maintenance. Which AWS service meets these requirements?
explanation: C is the correct answer. AWS Fargate is a serverless, pay-as-you-go compute engine that lets you focus on building applications without managing servers. AWS Fargate is compatible with both Amazon Elastic Container Service (Amazon ECS) and Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (Amazon EKS).

stem: A company wants to run a NoSQL database on Amazon EC2 instances. Which task is the responsibility of AWS in this scenario?

options.label: A
options.text: Update the guest operating system of the EC2 instances.

options.label: B
options.text: Maintain high availability at the database layer.

options.label: C
options.text: Patch the physical infrastructure that hosts the EC2 instances.

explanation: AWS is responsible for the physical infrastructure the EC2 instances run on. Running a database yourself on EC2 leaves you with the guest operating system, the database software, its availability and the security group rules.

stem: Which AWS services or tools can identify rightsizing opportunities for Amazon EC2 instances? (Select TWO.)
explanation: Cost Explorer surfaces EC2 rightsizing recommendations from your own usage history, and Compute Optimizer analyses utilisation metrics to recommend a better instance type or size. Billing Conductor produces custom billing views, CodeGuru reviews code, and SageMaker builds models - none of them size instances.

stem: Which of the following are benefits of using AWS Trusted Advisor? (Select TWO.)

options.label: C
options.text: Detecting underutilized resources to save costs

options.label: D
options.text: Improving security by proactively monitoring the AWS environment

options.label: E
options.text: Implementing enforced tagging across AWS resources

explanation: Trusted Advisor inspects the account and returns recommendations across cost optimization, performance, security, fault tolerance and service limits, so spotting underutilised resources and flagging security weaknesses are both benefits. It does not orchestrate containers, manage encryption keys, or enforce tagging.

stem: Which of the following is an advantage that users experience when they move on-premises workloads to the AWS Cloud?

options.label: A
options.text: Elimination of expenses for running and maintaining data centers

options.label: B
options.text: Price discounts that are identical to discounts from hardware providers

options.label: C
options.text: Distribution of all operational controls to AWS

explanation: Moving to AWS removes the capital and running cost of data centres - buildings, power, cooling and hardware refresh. Operational expense is not eliminated, it becomes a variable charge, and AWS does not take over the operational controls the customer owns.

stem: A company wants to manage deployed IT services and govern its infrastructure as code (IaC) templates. Which AWS service will meet this requirement?
explanation: AWS Service Catalog lets you centrally manage your cloud resources to achieve governance at scale of your infrastructure as code (IaC) templates, written in CloudFormation or Terraform configurations.

stem: Which AWS service or tool helps users visualize, understand, and manage spending and usage over time?
explanation: AWS Cost Explorer has an easy-to-use interface that lets you visualize, understand, and manage your AWS costs and usage over time.

stem: A company is using a central data platform to manage multiple types of data for its customers. The company wants to use AWS services to discover, transform, and visualize the data. Which combination of AWS services should the company use to meet these requirements? (Select TWO.)
explanation: AWS Glue is a serverless data integration service that makes it easier to discover, prepare, move, and integrate data from multiple sources for analytics, machine learning (ML), and application development. Amazon QuickSight powers data-driven organizations with unified business intelligence (BI) at hyperscale. With QuickSight, all users can meet varying analytic needs from the same source of truth through modern interactive dashboards, paginated reports, embedded analytics, and natural language queries.

stem: A global company wants to migrate its third-party applications to the AWS Cloud. The company wants help from a global team of experts to complete the migration faster and more reliably in accordance with AWS internal best practices. Which AWS service or resource will meet these requirements?
explanation: The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that can help you realize your desired business outcomes when using the AWS Cloud. We work together with your team and your chosen member of the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute your enterprise cloud computing initiatives.

stem: An e-learning platform needs to run an application for 2 months each year. The application will be deployed on Amazon EC2 instances. Any application downtime during those 2 months must be avoided. Which EC2 purchasing option will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?
explanation: On-Demand Instances are recommended for: • Users that prefer the low cost and flexibility of EC2 without any upfront payment or long-term commitment • Applications with short-term, spiky, or unpredictable workloads that cannot be interrupted • Applications being developed or tested on EC2 for the first time.

stem: A developer wants to deploy an application quickly on AWS without manually creating the required resources. Which AWS service will meet these requirements?
explanation: Deploy scalable web applications in minutes without the complexity of provisioning and managing underlying infrastructure.

stem: A company is storing sensitive customer data in an Amazon S3 bucket. The company wants to protect the data from accidental deletion or overwriting. Which S3 feature should the company use to meet these requirements?
explanation: Versioning-enabled buckets can help you recover objects from accidental deletion or overwrite.

stem: Which AWS service provides the ability to manage infrastructure as code?
explanation: AWS Cloud Formation lets you model, provision, and manage AWS and third-party resources by treating infrastructure as code.

stem: An online gaming company needs to choose a purchasing option to run its Amazon EC2 instances for 1 year. The web traffic is consistent, and any increases in traffic are predictable. The EC2 instances must be online and available without any disruption. Which EC2 instance purchasing option will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?
explanation: Amazon EC2 Reserved Instances (RI) provide a significant discount (up to 72%) compared to On-Demand pricing and provide a capacity reservation when used in a specific Availability Zone. Terms (avg. discount off On-Demand) - 1yr (40%), 3yr (60%).

stem: Which AWS service or feature allows a user to establish a dedicated network connection between a company’s on-premises data center and the AWS Cloud?
explanation: Create a dedicated network connection to AWS. The AWS Direct Connect cloud service is the shortest path to your AWS resources. While in transit, your network traffic remains on the AWS global network and never touches the public internet.

stem: Which option is a physical location of the AWS global infrastructure?
explanation: AWS has the concept of a Region, which is a physical location around the world where we cluster data centers. We call each group of logical data centers an Availability Zone. Each AWS Region consists of a minimum of three, isolated, and physically separate AZs within a geographic area.

stem: A company wants to protect its AWS Cloud information, systems, and assets while performing risk assessment and mitigation tasks. Which pillar of the AWS Well-Architected Framework is supported by these goals?
explanation: Security - For Infrastructure Protection and Data Protection.

stem: What is the purpose of having an internet gateway within a VPC?

options.label: A
options.text: To create a VPN connection to the VPC

options.label: B
options.text: To allow communication between the VPC and the internet

options.label: C
options.text: To impose bandwidth constraints on internet traffic

options.label: D
options.text: To load balance traffic from the internet across Amazon EC2 instances

explanation: An internet gateway is a horizontally scaled, redundant, and highly available VPC component that allows communication between your VPC and the internet.

stem: A company is running a monolithic on-premises application that does not scale and is difficult to maintain. The company has a plan to migrate the application to AWS and divide the application into microservices. Which best practice of the AWS Well-Architected Framework is the company following with this plan?

options.label: A
options.text: Integrate functional testing as part of AWS deployment.

options.label: C
options.text: Deploy the application to multiple locations.

explanation: Dependencies such as queuing systems, streaming systems, workflows, and load balancers are loosely coupled. Loose coupling helps isolate behaviour of a component from other components that depend on it, increasing resiliency and agility.

stem: A company has an AWS account. The company wants to audit its password and access key rotation details for compliance purposes. Which AWS service or tool will meet this requirement?
explanation: You can use credential reports to assist in your auditing and compliance efforts. You can use the report to audit the effects of credential lifecycle requirements, such as password and access key updates.

stem: A company wants to receive a notification when a specific AWS cost threshold is reached. Which AWS services or tools can the company use to meet this requirement? (Select TWO.)
explanation: AWS Budgets sends a notification when spend crosses a threshold you set, and a CloudWatch alarm on the billing metric does the same thing from the monitoring side. Cost Explorer and the Cost and Usage Report only report spend, and SQS is a message queue.

stem: Which AWS service or resource provides answers to the most frequently asked security-related questions that AWS receives from its users?
explanation: The AWS Knowledge Center publishes articles and videos answering the questions AWS receives most often, including the security ones. AWS Artifact holds audit reports rather than answers, and Amazon Connect and AWS Chatbot are unrelated services.

stem: Which tasks are customer responsibilities, according to the AWS shared responsibility model? (Select TWO.)

options.label: A
options.text: Configure the AWS provided security group firewall.

options.label: B
options.text: Classify company assets in the AWS Cloud.

options.label: C
options.text: Determine which Availability Zones to use for Amazon S3 buckets.

options.label: E
options.text: Select Amazon EC2 instances to run AWS Lambda on.

explanation: Configuring the security group firewall and classifying your own assets are both customer responsibilities. AWS chooses where S3 stores data within a Region and patches DynamoDB, and Lambda has no EC2 instances for a customer to select.

stem: Which of the following are pillars of the AWS Well-Architected Framework? (Select TWO.)
explanation: Reliability and operational excellence are two of the six Well-Architected pillars, alongside security, performance efficiency, cost optimization and sustainability. Availability, scalability and responsive design are not pillar names.

stem: Which AWS service or feature is used to send both text and email messages from distributed applications?
explanation: Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) sends notifications two ways, A2A and A2P. A2A provides high-throughput, push-based, many-to-many messaging between distributed systems, microservices, and event-driven serverless applications. These applications include Amazon Simple Queue Service (SQS), Amazon Kinesis Data Firehose, AWS Lambda, and other HTTPS endpoints. A2P functionality lets you send messages to your customers with SMS texts, push notifications, and email.

stem: A user needs programmatic access to AWS resources through the AWS CLI or the AWS API. Which option will provide the user with the appropriate access?

options.label: D
options.text: AWS Key Management Service (AWS KMS) keys

explanation: Access keys are long-term credentials for an IAM user or the AWS account root user. You can use access keys to sign programmatic requests to the AWS CLI or AWS API (directly or using the AWS SDK).

stem: A company runs thousands of simultaneous simulations using AWS Batch. Each simulation is stateless, is fault tolerant, and runs for up to 3 hours. Which pricing model enables the company to optimize costs and meet these requirements?
explanation: Spot Instances are a good fit for stateless, fault-tolerant workloads that can be interrupted without any impact on the overall job.

stem: What does the concept of agility mean in AWS Cloud computing? (Select TWO.)

options.label: A
options.text: The speed at which AWS resources are implemented

options.label: B
options.text: The speed at which AWS creates new AWS Regions

options.label: E
options.text: The low cost of entry into cloud computing

explanation: Agility is about speed: how fast resources can be brought online, and how cheaply an idea can be tried and discarded. How fast AWS builds Regions is not a customer benefit, and eliminating wasted capacity and low entry cost are cost benefits, not agility.

stem: A company needs to block SQL injection attacks. Which AWS service or feature can meet this requirement?
explanation: AWS WAF helps you protect against common web exploits and bots that can affect availability, compromise security, or consume excessive resources.

stem: Which AWS service or feature identifies whether an Amazon S3 bucket or an IAM role has been shared with an external entity?
explanation: IAM Access Analyzer helps identify resources in your organization and accounts that are shared with an external entity.

stem: A cloud practitioner needs to obtain AWS compliance reports before migrating an environment to the AWS Cloud. How can these reports be generated?

options.label: B
options.text: Download the reports from AWS Artifact.

options.label: C
options.text: Open a case with AWS Support.

options.label: D
options.text: Generate the reports with Amazon Macie.

explanation: AWS Artifact is a portal that provides access to various compliance reports, including certifications, attestations, and other relevant documents. You can download these reports directly from AWS Artifact.

stem: An ecommerce company has migrated its IT infrastructure from an on-premises data center to the AWS Cloud. Which cost is the company’s direct responsibility?

options.label: B
options.text: Cost of the hardware infrastructure on AWS

options.label: C
options.text: Cost of power for the AWS servers

options.label: D
options.text: Cost of physical security for the AWS data center

explanation: The customer keeps paying for the licences of the software it runs. The hardware, its power and the physical security of the data centre are priced into what AWS charges and are not separate customer costs.

stem: A company is setting up AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) on an AWS account. Which recommendation complies with IAM security best practices?

options.label: A
options.text: Use the account root user access keys for administrative tasks.

options.label: B
options.text: Grant broad permissions so that all company employees can access the resources they need.

options.label: C
options.text: Turn on multi-factor authentication (MFA) for added security during the login process.

options.label: D
options.text: Avoid rotating credentials to prevent issues in production applications.

explanation: Turn on multi-factor authentication (MFA) for added security during the login process. Enabling multi-factor authentication (MFA) for user accounts, especially for users with administrative or high-privilege access, is a crucial security best practice. MFA adds an additional layer of security by requiring users to provide two or more verification factors (typically something they know, like a password, and something they have, like a temporary MFA code from a hardware token or mobile app) before gaining access. This significantly reduces the risk of unauthorized access, even if login credentials are compromised.

stem: Elasticity in the AWS Cloud refers to which of the following? (Select TWO.)

options.label: A
options.text: How quickly an Amazon EC2 instance can be restarted

options.label: B
options.text: The ability to rightsize resources as demand shifts

options.label: C
options.text: The maximum amount of RAM an Amazon EC2 instance can use

options.label: E
options.text: How easily resources can be procured when they are needed

explanation: Elasticity is capacity following demand in both directions - resources sized up and down as load shifts, and acquired the moment they are needed. Restart time, instance memory limits and the billing model are not elasticity.

stem: Which service enables customers to audit API calls in their AWS accounts?
explanation: Cloud Trail is a service that enables governance, compliance, operational auditing, and risk auditing of your AWS account. It records and logs all API calls made within your account, including who made them, when they were made, and which resources were affected.

stem: What is a customer responsibility when using AWS Lambda according to the AWS shared responsibility model?

options.label: A
options.text: Managing the code within the Lambda function

options.label: B
options.text: Confirming that the hardware is working in the data center

options.label: D
options.text: Shutting down Lambda functions when they are no longer in use

explanation: With AWS Lambda the customer is responsible for the function code and its configuration. AWS owns the hardware, the operating system and its patching, and an idle function costs nothing, so there is nothing to shut down.

stem: A company has 5 TB of data stored in Amazon S3. The company plans to occasionally run queries on the data for analysis. Which AWS service should the company use to run these queries in the MOST cost-effective manner?
explanation: Amazon Athena is a serverless, interactive analytics service built on open-source frameworks, supporting open-table and file formats. Athena provides a simplified, flexible way to analyze petabytes of data where it lives. Analyze data or build applications from an Amazon Simple Storage Service (S3) data lake and 30 data sources, including on-premises data sources or other cloud systems using SQL or Python. Athena is built on open-source Trino and Presto engines and Apache Spark frameworks, with no provisioning or configuration effort required.

stem: Which AWS service can be used at no additional cost?
explanation: AWS Organizations is an account management service that enables you to consolidate multiple AWS accounts into an organization that you create and centrally manage. AWS Organizations is offered at no additional charge. You are charged only for AWS resources that users and roles in your member accounts use. For example, you are charged the standard fees for Amazon EC2 instances that are used by users or roles in your member accounts.

stem: Which AWS Cloud Adoption Framework (AWS CAF) capability belongs to the people perspective?
explanation: Cloud fluency is a people perspective capability. Data architecture belongs to platform, event management to operations, and strategic partnership to business.

stem: A company wants to make an upfront commitment for continued use of its production Amazon EC2 instances in exchange for a reduced overall cost. Which pricing options meet these requirements with the LOWEST cost? (Select TWO.)
explanation: Reserved Instances and Savings Plans are the two options that trade an upfront or hourly commitment for a lower rate on steady production usage. Spot is cheaper still but can be interrupted, and On-Demand and Dedicated Hosts involve no discount commitment.

stem: A company wants to migrate its on-premises relational databases to the AWS Cloud. The company wants to use infrastructure as close to its current geographical location as possible. Which AWS service or resource should the company use to select its Amazon RDS deployment area?
explanation: An AWS Region is the geographic choice: you pick the Region closest to your users or your current data centre and deploy Amazon RDS into it. Direct Connect is a network link, not a placement choice, and Wavelength targets 5G edge workloads.

stem: A company is exploring the use of the AWS Cloud, and needs to create a cost estimate for a project before the infrastructure is provisioned. Which AWS service or feature can be used to estimate costs before deployment?
explanation: AWS Pricing Calculator is a web-based planning tool that you can use to create estimates for your AWS use cases. You can use it to model your solutions before building them, explore the AWS service price points, and review the calculations behind your estimates.

stem: A company is building an application that needs to deliver images and videos globally with minimal latency. Which approach can the company use to accomplish this in a cost effective manner?

options.label: A
options.text: Deliver the content through Amazon CloudFront.

options.label: B
options.text: Store the content on Amazon S3 and enable S3 cross-region replication.

options.label: C
options.text: Implement a VPN across multiple AWS Regions.

options.label: D
options.text: Deliver the content through AWS PrivateLink.

explanation: Amazon CloudFront caches content at edge locations close to viewers, which cuts latency without replicating the whole data set. Cross-Region replication copies objects but still serves them from a Region, and PrivateLink is for private access, not global delivery.

stem: Which option is a benefit of the economies of scale based on the advantages of cloud computing?

options.label: A
options.text: The ability to trade variable expense for fixed expense

options.label: C
options.text: Lower variable costs over fixed costs

options.label: D
options.text: Increased operational costs across data centers

explanation: Economies of scale mean AWS aggregates the usage of many customers and buys at a scale no single organisation can match, so the pay-as-you-go variable rate falls. The cloud trades fixed capital expense for variable expense, not the other way round.

stem: Which of the following is a software development framework that a company can use to define cloud resources as code and provision the resources through AWS CloudFormation?
explanation: AWS Cloud Development Kit (AWS CDK)AWS CDK is a software development framework that enables developers to define infrastructure as code (IaC) using familiar programming languages like TypeScript, Python, Java, C#, and more. With AWS CDK, you can define cloud resources, their relationships, and provisioning logic in your preferred programming language. AWS CDK also generates CloudFormation templates based on your code, making it easier to manage and deploy infrastructure resources in AWS.

stem: A company is developing an application that uses multiple AWS services. The application needs to use temporary, limited-privilege credentials for authentication with other AWS APIs. Which AWS service or feature should the company use to meet these authentication requirements?
explanation: AWS Security Token Service (AWS STS)AWS STS provides a way to grant temporary, limited-privilege credentials to users, applications, or services. These temporary credentials can be used to access AWS resources securely without having to use long-term access keys or IAM user credentials.

stem: Which AWS service is a cloud security posture management (CSPM) service that aggregates alerts from various AWS services and partner products in a standardized format?
explanation: AWS Security Hub is a cloud security posture management (CSPM) service that performs automated, continuous security best practice checks against your AWS resources to help you identify misconfigurations, and aggregates your security alerts (i.e. findings) in a standardized format so that you can more easily enrich, investigate, and remediate them.

stem: Which AWS service is always provided at no charge?
explanation: IAM is a feature of your AWS account and is offered at no additional charge.

stem: To reduce costs, a company is planning to migrate a NoSQL database to AWS. Which AWS service is fully managed and can automatically scale throughput capacity to meet database workload demands?
explanation: Amazon DynamoDB is a fully managed NoSQL database service that provides fast and predictable performance with seamless scalability.

stem: A company is using Amazon DynamoDB. Which task is the company’s responsibility, according to the AWS shared responsibility model?
explanation: Managing who can read and write the DynamoDB tables is the customer half of the shared responsibility model. DynamoDB is a managed service, so AWS provisions the hosts and patches and secures the operating system.

stem: A company has a test AWS environment. A company is planning on testing an application within AWS. The application testing can be interrupted and does not need to run continuously. Which Amazon EC2 purchasing option will meet these requirements MOST cost-effectively?
explanation: Spot Instances are a good fit for stateless, fault-tolerant workloads that can be interrupted without any impact on the overall job.

stem: Which AWS service gives users the ability to discover and protect sensitive data that is stored in Amazon S3 buckets?
explanation: Amazon Macie Amazon Macie is a security service that uses machine learning to automatically discover, classify, and protect sensitive data in Amazon S3. It helps you identify and protect data such as personally identifiable information (PII), financial information, intellectual property, and more by monitoring data access and alerting you to potential security risks.

stem: Which of the following services can be used to block network traffic to an instance? (Select TWO.)

options.label: B
options.text: Amazon Virtual Private Cloud (Amazon VPC) flow logs

explanation: Security groups are stateful firewalls at the instance level and network ACLs are stateless firewalls at the subnet level; both can stop traffic reaching an instance. VPC flow logs, CloudWatch and CloudTrail only record what happened - none of them blocks anything.

stem: Which AWS service can identify when an Amazon EC2 instance was terminated?
explanation: AWS CloudTrailAWS CloudTrail is a service that records all API activity in your AWS account, including the termination of EC2 instances. It creates log entries for various events, providing an audit trail of actions taken on resources. By reviewing CloudTrail logs, you can identify when an EC2 instance was terminated, who initiated the termination, and other relevant details about the event.

stem: Which of the following is a fully managed MySQL-compatible database?
explanation: Amazon Aurora Amazon Aurora is a relational database service that is compatible with MySQL and PostgreSQL. It is fully managed by AWS and is designed for high availability, performance, and scalability while maintaining MySQL compatibility. Aurora offers features like automated backups, read replicas, and seamless failover to ensure data durability and availability. It's a popular choice for applications that require a MySQL-compatible database with the benefits of a fully managed service.

stem: Which AWS service supports a hybrid architecture that gives users the ability to extend AWS infrastructure, AWS services, APIs, and tools to data centers, co-location environments, or on-premises facilities?
explanation: AWS Outposts AWS Outposts enables you to run AWS infrastructure and services on premises while seamlessly connecting to the AWS cloud. This service extends the AWS ecosystem to your on-premises locations, allowing you to take advantage of cloud benefits while addressing the requirements of data residency, low-latency applications, and specific regulatory needs in hybrid environments.

stem: Which AWS service can run a managed PostgreSQL database that provides online transaction processing (OLTP)?
explanation: Amazon RDS (Relational Database Service)Amazon RDS supports various database engines, including PostgreSQL, and offers a managed database service suitable for OLTP workloads. With Amazon RDS for PostgreSQL, you can easily set up, operate, and scale a PostgreSQL database without the administrative overhead of managing the infrastructure.

stem: A company wants to provide managed Windows virtual desktops and applications to its remote employees over secure network connections. Which AWS services can the company use to meet these requirements? (Select TWO.)
explanation: Amazon WorkSpaces delivers the managed Windows desktops, and AWS Site-to-Site VPN gives the remote employees the secure network connection to reach them. AppStream 2.0 streams individual applications rather than full desktops.

stem: A company wants to monitor for misconfigured security groups that are allowing unrestricted access to specific ports. Which AWS service will meet this requirement?
explanation: AWS Trusted Advisor AWS Trusted Advisor is a service that provides recommendations for optimizing your AWS infrastructure. It includes checks for security best practices, such as identifying security groups that have overly permissive rules, which would allow unrestricted access to specific ports. It offers guidance on how to address these misconfigurations.

stem: Which AWS service is a key-value database that provides sub-millisecond latency on a large scale?
explanation: Amazon DynamoDB is a nonrelational database that delivers reliable performance at any scale. It's a fully managed, multi-region, multi-master database that provides consistent single-digit millisecond latency, and offers built-in security, backup and restore, and in-memory caching.

stem: A company is deploying a machine learning (ML) research project that will require a lot of compute power over several months. The ML processing jobs do not need to run at specific times. Which Amazon EC2 instance purchasing option will meet these requirements at the lowest cost?
explanation: Spot Instances Spot Instances are the most cost-effective option for workloads that can be flexible about when they run. They allow you to use spare Amazon EC2 capacity at a significantly lower price compared to On-Demand Instances. Spot Instances are ideal for workloads like batch processing, data analysis, and machine learning jobs that can be interrupted or scheduled flexibly.

stem: Which AWS services or features provide disaster recovery solutions for Amazon EC2 instances? (Select TWO.)

options.label: C
options.text: Amazon Elastic Block Store (Amazon EBS) snapshots

explanation: An Amazon Machine Image captures a whole instance so a replacement can be launched from it, and EBS snapshots capture point-in-time copies of the volumes - together they are the recovery points for EC2. Reserved Instances are a pricing option, and Shield and GuardDuty are security services.

stem: Which AWS service provides command line access to AWS tools and resources directly from a web browser?
explanation: Using AWS Cloud Shell, a browser-based shell, you can quickly run scripts with the AWS Command Line Interface (CLI), experiment with service APIs using the AWS CLI, and use other tools to increase your productivity. The Cloud Shell icon appears in AWS Regions where Cloud Shell is available.

stem: A network engineer needs to build a hybrid cloud architecture connecting on-premises networks to the AWS Cloud using AWS Direct Connect. The company has a few VPCs in a single AWS Region and expects to increase the number of VPCs to hundreds over time. Which AWS service or feature should the engineer use to simplify and scale this connectivity as the VPCs increase in number?
explanation: AWS Transit Gateway connects your Amazon Virtual Private Clouds (VPCs) and on-premises networks through a central hub. This connection simplifies your network and puts an end to complex peering relationships. Transit Gateway acts as a highly scalable cloud router—each new connection is made only once.

stem: A company wants to assess its operational readiness. It also wants to identify and mitigate any operational risks ahead of a new product launch. Which AWS Support plan offers guidance and support for this kind of event at no additional charge?
explanation: AWS Countdown (formerly Infrastructure Event Management) is included at no extra charge with Enterprise Support, which is what covers operational readiness assessment and risk mitigation before a launch. Business Support customers can buy it separately.

stem: A company wants to establish a schedule for rotating database user credentials. Which AWS service will support this requirement with the LEAST amount of operational overhead?
explanation: AWS Secrets Manager stores database credentials and rotates them on a schedule with a built-in rotation function, so there is nothing to build. Systems Manager Parameter Store holds parameters but does not rotate database credentials for you.

stem: Which AWS service or feature can be used to create a private connection between an on-premises workload and an AWS Cloud workload?
explanation: Direct connect is for private dedicated connection between on premise and AWS.PrivateLink is used when you comunicate with third party VPC and it Requires a network load balancer (Service VPC) and ENI (Customer VPC) AWS PrivateLink: Establish connectivity between VPCs and AWS services without exposing data to the internetDirectConnect: Create a dedicated network connection to AWS.

stem: Which AWS service is used to provide encryption for Amazon EBS?
explanation: Use Amazon EBS encryption as a straight-forward encryption solution for your EBS resources associated with your EC2 instances. With Amazon EBS encryption, you aren't required to build, maintain, and secure your own key management infrastructure. Amazon EBS encryption uses AWS KMS keys when creating encrypted volumes and snapshots.
